Opportunity summary:
- Large logistics operator evaluating Redwood Dedicated for live driver-assist chat + routing embeddings/reranking. Heavy emphasis on predictable throughput for peak periods and hard latency SLOs for customer-facing chat.

Decision context and primary asks:
- Throughput target: sustain 500 concurrent chat streams (avg 64-token responses) with headroom for 2x bursts during peak (weekday 08:00-10:30 local).
- Latency SLO: 95th pct < 150ms for streaming chat token latency; P50 target 50ms.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial commit = 8x A100 80GB equivalent (or 4x H100 pref), with burst capacity via Dedicated autoscale config. Want topology map: 2x slices for EU customers.
- Uptime & SLA negotiations: Crestgate legal pushing for 99.99% but business willing to accept baseline 99.95% if credit schedule is meaningful. Current proposed credit tiers (negotiation points):
    * >=99.95%: no credit (Redwood baseline) — Crestgate wants baseline credit of 10% for <99.95%
    * 99.90-99.95%: 10% service credit — Crestgate asking 20%
    * 99.75-99.90%: 30% credit (dispute around cap)
    * <99.75%: 50% credit and escalation to executive SLA review.
- Maintenance windows: prefer scheduled maintenance Sundays 02:00-04:00 UTC, max 2 planned maintenance events/month; require 72h advance notice and a rollback/mitigation plan. Crestgate requires no unrecoverable cache wipes during maintenance.
- Support & response times (legal wants hard SLAs):
    * P1 (service down / production impacting): response acknowledgement <15 minutes; mitigation/update every 30 minutes; resolution target 4 hours (ask: Crestgate wants 2 hours for P1)
    * P2 (degraded performance / partial outage): response <2 hours; resolution target 24 hours
    * P3 (non-critical): response within 1 business day
- Pen test & compliance: need SOC2 type II report, ISO27001 certificate, third-party pen test results. KMS/HSM integration mandatory for key material.
- Data residency: EU regional tenancy required for EU customer workload. Private control-plane for EU biz suggested.
